marketName: Will Jensen Huang cease to be Chief Executive Officer of NVIDIA Corporation before 2026-12-01 05:00 UTC (the end of 30 November 2026, US Eastern Time)? Resolves Yes if NVIDIA states, in an SEC filing (for example a Form 8-K under Item 5.02) or an official press release, that Jensen Huang has ceased to be CEO, effective before that time, for any reason. A leave of absence, a reduction of duties, or a departure that is announced but takes effect after that time does not count. Otherwise resolves No.
